The electricity produced accounted for 43.8% of the wastewater treatment plant and main pumping station’s annual consumption.'

factual_claims.claim: Net financial expense decreased to €3.78 million from €4.20 million, mainly because of lower Euribor rates.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Expenses section states: 'The group’s net financial income and expenses have resulted in a net expense of €3.78 million (2024: €4.20 million). This decrease was mainly due to the lower Euribor rate.'

factual_claims.claim: Profit before tax rose 18.0% to €17.43 million, while net profit increased 7.2% to €14.24 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income shows Profit before taxes increased 18.0% to €17,434 thousand and Net profit increased 7.2% to €14,242 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: The smaller increase in net profit reflected the higher income-tax rate on dividend payments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Profit before taxes and Net profit section states: 'Net profit was affected by an increase in the income tax rate on dividend payments.'

factual_claims.claim: The 2025 dividend had not been declared when the report was issued; €10.60 million, or €0.53 per share, was paid from 2024 profit.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Dividends section states: 'In the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on 22/05/2025, the Supervisory Council proposed to pay out €0.53 per share from the 2024 profits... The dividend pay-out was made on 17/06/2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Investment accelerated, with €55.74 million invested in fixed assets versus €49.53 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Financial Position note states: 'In 2025, the group invested into fixed assets €55.74 million. In 2024, this amount was €49.53 million.'

factual_claims.claim: The expansion was financed partly through additional borrowing: outstanding loans increased to €160 million from €118 million, while the debt-to-assets ratio rose to 66.02% from 61.71%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Financial Position shows Group’s outstanding loans amount to €160 million (2024: €118 million). Debt to total assets ratio is 66.02% (2024: 61.71%).

factual_claims.claim: Cash increased to €11.29 million from €3.59 million, supported by €45 million of new loans and operating cash flow of €30.83 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Statement of Cash Flows shows Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period was €11,294 thousand (2024: €3,589 thousand). Received loans were €45,000 thousand. Total cash flows from operating activities were €30,827 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: The group retained a €6.02 million provision for tariff-related claims, against claims totalling €14.67 million, and no final judgment had been issued.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Provision for possible third-party claims section states: 'As at 31 December 2025, claims brought in the five actions totalled €14.67 million... The Management Board has estimated the potential liability... at €6 million... As at 31/12/2025, one case was pending in the court of second instance, while the other four were pending in the court of first instance or had been reviewed. No final judgement has yet been issued.'

factual_claims.claim: PwC issued an unqualified opinion on the consolidated financial statements.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Independent Auditor’s Report states: 'In our opinion, the consolidated financial statements present fairly, in all material respects...'
